subject: Graduate Engineer application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Martinus recruitment team,

I'm applying for the Graduate Engineer role on the Inland Rail Albury to Parkes Enhancement Project that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as a field engineer and project-in-charge, doing site inspections and quality checks, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day and writing progress reports.

Your advert asks for people who are coachable, driven and keen to learn in a fast paced project, which is how I want to start in rail. I'm based in Melton VIC, available for regional project work and open to discussing relocation near Forbes. I hold an Australian driver's licence, a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't worked in rail yet, so I would start at graduate level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Engineer role on the Inland Rail Albury to Parkes Enhancement Project advertised on SEEK. Learning on a major regional rail project with a team that values coachable, driven people is the start I want for my civil career.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D using Australian Standards, and prepared cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site, material and progress reports. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings against project requirements and kept the client up to date.

I hold an Australian driver's licence and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am based in Melton VIC, available for regional project work and open to discussing relocation near Forbes. I have not yet worked in rail or on Australian infrastructure projects, so I would start at graduate level and learn quickly from your engineers on site.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
